name: Pakka Limited
summary: Pakka Limited, established in 1981 and based in Ayodhya, was known as Yash Pakka Limited until July 2023. It makes and sells paper-based and molded products in India and for export, in two divisions: Paper, Pulp, and Other Products, and Moulded Products. Its range includes CHUK-brand molded food service items, agricultural pulp, kraft papers and flexible packaging.
